subject: [PATCH v9 27/32] mm: handle PMD swap entries in MADV_WILLNEED

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch improves handling of PMD swap entries in MADV_WILLNEED operations by prefetching the whole range as one PMD-order folio instead of walking PTEs individually. This approach avoids issues with order-0 readahead and faults that follow, and also considers changes to the THP policy since the range was swapped out. The patch introduces a new function `swapin_pmd_swap_entry` that handles this scenario and allows for fallback to PTEs in case of errors or split cache configurations.
